thread:
Maya Luo: Quick design check — iterating on the Playground chat streaming UI. Attached screenshot + short vid: https://img.redwood.dev/plays/stream-ux.mp4. Two things I want feedback on: 1) Stop vs Regenerate placement while streaming, 2) Token counter behavior when using the prompt library (insert flow). Also noticed contrast on token pill in dark mode.

Ryan Chen: My take — make Stop the prominent primary action while streaming. Users expect an obvious interruption control. Suggestion: Swap positions so Stop is left of Regenerate and use a filled destructive style for Stop (red), outline for Regenerate. Keep keyboard shortcut for Regenerate (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) but add a dedicated Stop shortcut (Esc or Shift+Esc?).

Jules Park: Accessibility nit: when streaming starts/stops we should fire a polite aria-live announcement like: "Assistant streaming started" / "Assistant streaming stopped". Also ensure Stop has aria-label that includes purpose: "Stop streaming response". For the token counter, expose an accessible label: "Token estimate: 42 (updating)" and update it when stable.

Samira K.: Token counter bug I hit — if you click Stop while the stream is mid-token the counter freezes showing the pre-stop estimate, not the final. Repro steps: open prompt library, pick `sales_summary`, insert, hit Generate, after ~1s click Stop. Counter stays at previous value. We should either: keep live estimate during stream and then switch to final count on end, or grey-out the counter while stream is active to avoid misleading numbers. My preference: show live estimate + a small transient badge that flips to final once generation completes.

Kevin O.: Keyboard order: Tab should hit Stop and Regenerate before the prompt drawer button. Current tab order puts prompt drawer first which is frustrating. Also, when prompt library inserts a prompt and triggers generation, focus should move to the composer input (so keyboard users can continue editing). For mobile: Stop needs a larger touch target — bump to 44px min.

Maya Luo: Good points. For copy tweaks, propose: Stop button text = "Stop" (primary) with tooltip "Stop generation (Esc)"; Regenerate tooltip = "Regenerate (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter)". Token pill copy: "Tokens: 42 (est.)" -> "Tokens: 42" after final.

Jules Park: Small aria addition: use `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the token counter region and `role=\"status\"` so screen readers pick up the change but it's not intrusive. If we grey out the counter during streaming, update the accessible text to "Token estimate updating".

Samira K.: Contrast: token pill in dark theme is `#5b6a77` on `#0f1720` — failing AA. Proposal: switch to `#d1e6ff` text on `#1b2430` or use semi-bold for legibility. Also the stop button red needs to be `#d6454a` not the current `#ff6b6b` for contrast with white text.

Maya Luo: Quick CSS suggestion (prototype):
```
.token-pill {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-strong);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.stream-stop { background: #d6454a; color: #fff; }
```
Not final, just a starting point.

Ryan Chen: UX microcopy: change prompt library insert button from "Insert" to "Add to composer" — more explicit. Also when inserting while streaming, show a tiny toast: "Prompt queued — will run after current generation" (or ask: should we cancel current stream and run new prompt?). We need product decision here.

Maya Luo: Good call. I think default should be to queue the insert (non-disruptive). Provide a small inline control "Run now (cancel current)" in the toast for power users.

Kevin O.: On focus/keyboard: when a toast shows "Prompt queued" it should be non-modal but focusable. Allow `Enter` to accept "Run now" and `Esc` to dismiss toast. Also screen reader should announce toast content via `aria-live`.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/boards/streaming-ux/123 (build 9843).

ui-test-bot: Accessibility smoke found 1 issue: token counter contrast fails in dark theme (WCAG AA). See report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/9843/report.

Maya Luo: Thanks — I'll patch colors and update ARIA. I'll push a tiny PR with changes and link it here. Will also add the aria-live region + swap button order in the HTML.

Ryan Chen: Quick implementation note: keep Stop idempotent — clicking Stop while already stopped should be a noop and not reenable the composer.

Maya Luo: Plan: I'll open PR with three small commits: (1) button reorder + keyboard shortcuts, (2) aria-live/token copy & accessible labels, (3) color token/stop contrast tweaks. Will ping design for a final pass. Any objections?

Jules Park: No objections. +1 for the aria changes.

Samira K.: +1, will review color tokens.

Kevin O.: I'll add keyboard test cases to the e2e suite.

Maya Luo: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
